kernel.governing_law: Four discrete angels, held for a precise time-coordinate, are released as causal agents who command a countable cavalry to kill a counted fraction of humanity.
kernel.mutated_relation: The four angels are not causal agents who command the cavalry; they are local registrations where a continuous extinction-wave becomes momentarily countable — agency belongs to the distributed process, and the hour-day-month-year are not a schedule but cross-sectional slices through which the wave's passage is witnessed, so that the bounded entities exist as cost-marks the wave inscribes rather than sources from which destruction flows.
